# ferentin_mcp_local_servers (Data Source)

List every local MCP server in the tenant (`ferentin_mcp_local_server`): ones an administrator declared or added from the catalog, and ones devices reported (`managed_by = "system"`, `declared_via` null). Sorted by display name.

Every item carries `import_id`, the ID its resource's `import` block takes, and `managed_by`, who created it (`console`, `iac`, …). Filter on `managed_by = "console"` to find what Terraform does not manage yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every local MCP server in the tenant: ones an administrator declared or added
# from the catalog, and ones devices reported.
data "ferentin_mcp_local_servers" "all" {}

# Servers devices are running that nobody has decided on yet.
output "pending_review" {
  value = [for s in data.ferentin_mcp_local_servers.all.servers : s.display_name if s.status == "pending"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant to list. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `servers` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `argv_template` (List of String)
- `declared_via` (String) `template`, `catalog`, or null for a server a device reported.
- `display_name` (String)
- `effective_status` (String)
- `import_id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<server_id>`, for an `import` block.
- `kind` (String) `local` or `remote`.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Who wrote it last. Divergence from `managed_by` means it changed hands.
- `managed_by` (String) Who created it: `console`, `iac`, `cli`, `system` or `unknown`. Never changes.
- `packages` (List of String)
- `server_id` (String)
- `status` (String) `pending`, `approved` or `blocked`.
